key_insight: A measure-theoretic log-derivative estimator enables unbiased Monte Carlo gradients for parametric Markov chains without constructing the global state space or solving linear systems.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can optimize expected rewards and reachability probabilities using sampled trajectories, including in continuous-state systems.
method: Sample trajectories instead of materializing the global state space.
Use local transition probabilities or densities and their parameter derivatives.
Apply a generalized log-derivative trick to estimate gradients.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluations on synthetic discrete chains and continuous-state case studies, with faster execution and scaling beyond existing solvers.
watch_item: Unbiasedness requires almost-sure termination and regularity conditions; estimator variance and long trajectories may still affect practical efficiency.
paper_title: Log-Derivative Trick for Parametric Markov Chains
